decisions.quote: We conducted a preregistered replication of the study entitled “People systematically overlook subtractive changes” (Adams et al., 2021). Our results were consistent with the original results. Overall, we replicated the effect of the overlooking of subtractive changes in a diverse French sample with a highly powered study.
decisions.reason: Although the authors note that the cue also increased additive ideas unlike in the original study, they state an explicit overall verdict that their results were consistent with the original results and that overall they replicated the overlooking of subtractive changes (and replicated the effects with similar effect sizes). Under Rule 1, an explicit overall verdict on the replication as a whole outweighs an individual stated contrast, making the outcome successful.
